nodes.statement: A Boot Progress PropertiesChanged signal for host0 triggers the registered Hypervisor callback.
The signal match is restricted to the host0 object and Boot Progress interface.
The callback enters bootProgressChangeEvent with the received D-Bus message.
The registered match forwards each matching message to bootProgressChangeEvent.
bootProgressChangeEvent creates storage for the changed BootProgress property data.
The callback owns the parsed changed-property map during dispatch.
Reading the signal populates the changed-property map used to find BootProgress.
A present BootProgress value is passed to updateCurrentHostState for state mapping.
A boot-progress value outside the recognized running and standby stages maps CurrentHostState to Off.
The Unspecified path restores both current state and requested transition to Off.
The callback releases its local parsed message data when dispatch returns.
Callers observe Standby, Running, or Off through the CurrentHostState property.
The BasicPaths unit test checks invalid, SystemInitComplete, OSRunning, and Unspecified mappings.

edges.statement: Only a PropertiesChanged signal matching the configured host0 Boot Progress rule enters this flow.
A matching Boot Progress signal invokes bootProgressChangeEvent.
The signal callback dispatches the received message into the boot-progress parser.
Message dispatch creates local storage for parsed changed properties.
The callback retains ownership of the local changed-property map while parsing.
Reading the D-Bus message populates the callback-owned property map.
Finding BootProgress in the parsed map causes updateCurrentHostState to run.
The state mapper routes unrecognized boot-progress values to its Off fallback.
The fallback resolves unsupported or unspecified progress to a safe Off state.
After the state update, callback return releases the parsed message data.
The completed callback leaves the mapped CurrentHostState externally observable.
The BasicPaths test asserts the externally observable state for each direct mapping input.

disconfirming_checks.statement: The mapping test must distinguish invalid, SystemInitComplete, OSRunning, and Unspecified results.
A D-Bus message parse exception is logged and returns before BootProgress lookup or state update.
